description: Configure roles that automatically ban users when assigned. When a user receives one of these roles, they will be immediately banned from the server. Users with the "Manage Roles" permission are exempt.

content.name: roleID
content.description: When a user receives this role, they will be immediately banned from the server. Users with the "Manage Roles" permission are exempt.

content.name: reason
content.description: The reason shown in the audit log when a user is banned for receiving this role.

content.name: deleteMessageDays
content.description: Number of days of messages to delete when banning the user (0-7).
